enemy.name: Aged Mead
enemy.flavour_text: Mead that has been aged for more than a decade, with a strong flowery scent. The Liquor Association stole it to deal a blow to the Mead Association, an attempt that resulted in some of its members turning traitor, leading to turmoil within. It has now become a weapon of revenge for the Liquor Association.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked, causes the target Operator to be Stunned while on the battlefield; added to the Deployment Waiting Zone as <Long Live Mead!> when defeated
